the_trade_off_made: We favoured impact and security/legal risk over pure monitoring severity and customer‑expressed urgency. This means a low‑severity security alert jumps ahead of a legal request, costing a slight delay on the compliance ticket but protecting the platform and avoiding possible breach penalties.
hardest_call: Balancing the legal deletion request (NEW-00002) against the suspected security incident (NEW-00004) was toughest; either could be justified as third, but we placed security higher to respect the explicit policy lift.

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: Impact on users and work blockage directly affect business continuity, which was the dominant factor across tickets.
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: It can undervalue legal or security obligations that have low immediate user impact but high downstream risk

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: Statutory and SLA deadlines dictate urgency beyond raw impact, especially for compliance tickets.
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: May push a less‑critical but time‑sensitive request ahead of a higher‑impact incident

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: Considers customer sentiment and equity, useful when impact metrics are similar.
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: Subjective and can be skewed by angry customers exaggerating severity

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: All tickets are from free plans, so revenue provides no useful differentiation.
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: Ignores potential long‑term value of high‑paying customers, though not relevant here

why_the_winner_beat_the_runner_up: Damage outranked deadline because the lockout affected thousands and blocked a live demo, a concrete business loss that outweighed any timing considerations.

reasons_before_correction.NEW-00001: Critical team lockout affecting all users and blocking work with a demo in hours forces it to the top.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00003: Widespread payment failures block transactions for many users, making it the next priority.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00004: Potential security breach, despite low monitored impact, is lifted by policy to at least third place.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00002: Legal data deletion request must be handled within statutory time, so it stays within the top four.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00005: Dashboard showing stale data impacts few users and can wait behind higher‑impact issues.
